context.problem: Enforcing organizational style guides, brand terminology, and phone/address formatting.
context.use_case: Automated in-line brand linting across browser and document editors.

rationale: In Benchmark Test 08, Grammarly Business successfully flagged brand abbreviations and phone formatting defects based on configured custom rules. Listed as an entity consistency resource; blind to unconfigured real-world facts.
when_to_consider: For brand style guide and terminology linting across team writers.
when_not_to_use: As an autonomous fact-checker or medical truth verifier.
